# Remote Control Agent v0.1.42 — Windows Session transport lifetime

- Spec [#62](https://github.com/lirtual/github-actions/issues/62): correct the Windows job-scoped, one-shot GitHub OIDC parent -> long-lived credential-free WSS Agent handoff. Node child spawning now uses the documented detached + ignored stdio + unref combination so the child can outlive its registration parent on Windows; RUNNER_TRACKING_ID and the original physical deadline remain, preserving GitHub job cleanup and server-side authorization.
- In v0.1.41 production, Ubuntu enrolled and passed signed WSS/Shell/file/revoke/Stop E2E; two Windows GitHub-hosted Sessions registered but remained offline. This source fix is a diagnosis, NOT proof of restored Windows operation. Windows real E2E is mandatory after this Release before declaring success.
- Source [Agent PR #84](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/84) on exact main SHA ff323600a63afd255544b90ca86b80a1eed5873c. Three-platform candidate CI [#41210452207](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/actions/runs/41210452207) passed; downloaded artifacts independently hashed against CI SHA256SUMS and bundle.json.
- No new persistent service, token retention, device identity, Workflow revision or Worker. Production remained temporarily on known working v0.1.40 until this Release and its native Windows E2E. The Release pin merge triggers publication and must be reviewed/authorized. Existing browser retirement and permanent Agent modes remain unchanged.
